help: Whether this daemon answered the scrape.
name: nibrunner_up

help: What the host has, by resource.
name: nibrunner_host_capacity

help: What the host has left to give a new app.
name: nibrunner_host_allocatable

help: 1 for the state an app is in, 0 for every state it is not.
name: nibrunner_app_state

help: Times an app's tenant has been restarted inside its guest since the host last booted the app afresh.
name: nibrunner_app_restarts_total

help: What a guest reported using, when it was last measured.
name: nibrunner_app_memory_used_bytes

help: The share of one vCPU a guest was using, when it was last measured.
name: nibrunner_app_cpu_share

help: How long an app has been held, by what it was holding: memory while it runs, a snapshot on disk while it sleeps.
name: nibrunner_app_time_seconds_total

help: What an app's guest has reported spending, summed across the vCPUs it was given.
name: nibrunner_app_cpu_seconds_total

help: What has crossed an app's tap, by which way it went. Only what was let out is counted as sent.
name: nibrunner_app_network_bytes_total

help: What an app has held on disk over time: what was set aside for it, and what its guest reported filling.
name: nibrunner_app_disk_mib_seconds_total

help: Requests this proxy answered, by what it answered with.
name: nibrunner_proxy_requests_total

help: Deciding a route and getting an answer back from the app. Ends when the response is handed on to be written, so it counts neither the handshake before it nor the write after.
name: nibrunner_proxy_request_duration_seconds

help: Requests the proxy has taken and not yet answered.
name: nibrunner_proxy_requests_in_flight

help: TLS handshakes at the proxy, by how they ended.
name: nibrunner_proxy_tls_handshakes_total

help: What requests to one app cost this proxy. Divide the rate of the sum by the rate of the count for that app's mean.
name: nibrunner_app_request_duration_seconds

help: Requests routed to an app, by the class of the status that came back. A 502 for an app that could not be reached is the proxy's and counted apart below.
name: nibrunner_app_requests_total

help: Requests routed to an app that nothing answered, so the proxy answered 502 for it.
name: nibrunner_app_requests_unreachable_total

help: Requests routed to an app that are still being answered: from arrival until the last byte of the response body, or until a websocket closes. An app with one open is not quiet.
name: nibrunner_app_requests_open

help: Sessions on an app's raw ports — a TCP connection, or a UDP client address — by what came of them: relayed, the app was down, its wake was refused, or it would not take the session. Only for apps with a raw port.
name: nibrunner_raw_port_sessions_total

help: What the relay carried on an app's raw ports, by which way it went: in is towards the app. A TCP session's bytes are counted when it ends.
name: nibrunner_raw_port_bytes_total

help: Bringing a sleeping app back for the request that asked for it, from the request reaching the waker to the app being ready to be forwarded one, whether it set the wake going or joined one under way. On an on-request host this is the population that makes the tail of nibrunner_proxy_request_duration_seconds.
name: nibrunner_wake_duration_seconds

help: Pausing a guest that has gone quiet and writing its memory out. Scales with the memory the app was given, so it is the cost of the sleep rather than of the app.
name: nibrunner_vm_snapshot_duration_seconds

help: Bringing a guest back from the snapshot it slept in. The other half of the sleep, and cheaper than it by orders of magnitude.
name: nibrunner_vm_restore_duration_seconds

help: One wake, by how it was done and the stretch of it: waiting for what readyWhen names once the microVM was back, and the whole. Total less ready is bringing the microVM back; the VMM's own part of that is nibrunner_vm_restore_duration_seconds.
name: nibrunner_wake_phase_seconds

help: Requests that found a wake of their app already under way and waited on it.
name: nibrunner_wake_requests_coalesced_total

help: The request that woke an app, from being handed to the app to the app answering it. What being ready was worth.
name: nibrunner_wake_first_response_seconds

help: Wakes this host refused, by why.
name: nibrunner_wake_refusals_total

help: What the HTTP activator answered requests for on-request apps with. The proxy counts every one of these as served, because serving it is what it did.
name: nibrunner_activator_responses_total

help: Putting an app to sleep, by why and the stretch of it: how late the policy was acted on past what it allowed, asking the guest to flush, and the whole of the flush and the snapshot. The snapshot alone is nibrunner_vm_snapshot_duration_seconds.
name: nibrunner_sleep_phase_seconds

help: Times a policy said an app may sleep, by what came of it: it slept, its microVM refused to be snapshotted, or the snapshot failed.
name: nibrunner_sleep_outcomes_total

help: Times an on-request app was woken by a request, by how.
name: nibrunner_app_wakes_total

help: What the last wake of an on-request app took. Absent until it has been woken.
name: nibrunner_app_last_wake_seconds

help: Times a policy said an on-request app may sleep, by what came of it.
name: nibrunner_app_sleeps_total

help: What the last sleep of an on-request app took, flush and snapshot. Absent until it has slept.
name: nibrunner_app_last_sleep_seconds

help: What this host runs, as labels on a 1.
name: nibrunner_build_info

help: When this daemon started, as seconds since the epoch.
name: nibrunner_process_start_time_seconds

help: 1 for the state the host reports itself in, 0 for every state it is not.
name: nibrunner_host_state

help: 1 once a pass over the document has run to the end since this daemon started.
name: nibrunner_host_reconciled

help: 1 while every app is what its document asks for.
name: nibrunner_host_converged

help: 1 while the last pass left work it could not do yet, such as a volume still held by an app on its way down.
name: nibrunner_host_deferred_work

help: 1 while the isolation ruleset is applied. Nothing is started or woken while it is not.
name: nibrunner_host_isolated

help: A pass from the document to the host, by what set it going.
name: nibrunner_reconcile_seconds

help: When the last pass over the document finished, as seconds since the epoch. 0 until one has.
name: nibrunner_reconcile_last_pass_timestamp_seconds

help: A pass from the host to the record: probing what is up, settling each state, applying the ruleset and the routes, writing down what it found.
name: nibrunner_refresh_seconds

help: Times the desired state file was there and could not be read as a document.
name: nibrunner_desired_state_unreadable_total

help: When reported.json was last written, as seconds since the epoch. 0 until it has been.
name: nibrunner_report_written_timestamp_seconds

help: How long giving an app what its document asked for took, from the change being noticed, by the stretch of the work: fetching its layers, readying its volume, booting it, and waiting for it to be ready. Total is the whole of it.
name: nibrunner_converge_seconds

help: Asks this host set out on, by how they ended: the app got there, or the next ask for it came first.
name: nibrunner_converge_outcomes_total

help: 1 while an app is what its document asks for, 0 while it is not.
name: nibrunner_app_converged

help: How long an app has been on its way to what its document asks for. 0 once it got there.
name: nibrunner_app_converging_seconds

help: What the last ask for an app took, by the stretch of the work. Absent while one is under way.
name: nibrunner_app_last_converge_seconds

help: A health probe, by what it found. One that found nothing ran out the check's timeout.
name: nibrunner_health_probe_seconds

help: Probes of an app, by the kind of check and what it found. For a boot-completed check, a probe is the microVM being up.
name: nibrunner_app_health_probes_total

help: Times an app failed, by where on the way up it did: refused by the document, no slot, its layers, its volume, the boot, the microVM stopping without being asked, nothing answering inside it, or its restarts running out.
name: nibrunner_app_failures_total

help: Times an app that had been answering stopped, for long enough to be called unhealthy, by the kind of check that said so.
name: nibrunner_app_unhealthy_total

help: When an app last answered a probe, as seconds since the epoch. 0 for one that never has.
name: nibrunner_app_last_healthy_timestamp_seconds

help: Starts attempted against an app's restart budget in its current window. Resets when a start has held for the policy's resetAfterMs.
name: nibrunner_app_start_attempts

help: Something done to storage or the artifact store on an app's behalf, by what and how it ended.
name: nibrunner_storage_operation_seconds

help: Layers a pass asked for that were already in the cache, so nothing was fetched.
name: nibrunner_layers_cached_total

help: What has been pulled from the artifact store, as the store sized it.
name: nibrunner_layer_fetch_bytes_total

help: 1 for the state a volume is in, 0 for every state it is not.
name: nibrunner_volume_state

help: What a volume was set aside as.
name: nibrunner_volume_size_bytes

help: What a guest reported filling of its volume, when it was last measured. Absent until it has been.
name: nibrunner_volume_used_bytes

help: 1 for the state a checkpoint is in, 0 for every state it is not.
name: nibrunner_checkpoint_state

help: 1 for the state an export is in, 0 for every state it is not.
name: nibrunner_export_state

help: What an export came to, once written. Absent until it has been.
name: nibrunner_export_size_bytes

help: Slots on this host: each holds an app's ports, tap and guest address, and an app with none is refused. The total is max_apps in config.toml, or the desired state's maxApps when that is more.
name: nibrunner_slots

help: What the kernel says it could give out without swapping, as against the promises nibrunner_host_allocatable adds up. Absent where the kernel does not say.
name: nibrunner_host_memory_available_bytes

help: Starts a pass refused, by why: no room in memory beside what is already up, or the isolation ruleset not applied. One refused for room waits, pending, and is planned again the next pass.
name: nibrunner_start_refusals_total

help: When a guest last reported what it was using, as seconds since the epoch. 0 for one that never has; one that stopped is one this host can no longer hear.
name: nibrunner_app_measured_timestamp_seconds

help: The kernel's connection-tracking table, which every flow between the proxy and a guest and every flow a guest opens is an entry of, for its lifetime and 120 s after. Full, the kernel drops packets for every app on the host. max_apps in config.toml sizes the max. Absent where the kernel tracks nothing.
name: nibrunner_conntrack_entries
